text: ncept should be changed and the concerned government and medical personal should attach great importance to this matter;clinical pharmacist system should be pushed forward and pharmaceutical service mode should be reconstructed;research on drug interactions should be broadened and research in mechanism of action of drug interactions as well as the interactions between traditional Chinese medicine and western medicines should be strengthened;construction of information should be sped up and database of drug interactions should be set up;propagate education should be emphasized to elevate people's knowledge on medicine etc.一是必须明确是因感冒引起的咳嗽，符合《治疗指南》的相关规定并伴咳嗽的患者，方可采用此方法；二是排除其他病因，包括患有高血压服用血管紧张素转换酶抑制剂者，以及急性支气管炎、急性鼻窦炎、过敏性鼻炎、慢性支气管炎急性发作、支气管哮喘、细菌性鼻窦炎及咳嗽变异型哮喘、鼻后滴流综合征、嗜酸粒细胞性支气管炎、胃一食管反流性咳嗽患者；三是因咳嗽程度不同，可适当变换上述4条自愈原则，须灵活掌握。
source: 对医院用药中药物相互作用问题的思考_史国兵.pdf
